request.recipient: Intersect Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund Oura by TxPipe maintenance and enhancement for 12 months, including part-time maintainer work, community support, documentation, protocol compatibility, performance improvements, bug fixing, and AI-friendly integration resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement and a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The maintenance funding is described as 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve to fund a part-time Oura maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
Oura is a Rust-native pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs for processing.
Oura supports multiple data sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC, and multiple sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS services, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
The proposal states that Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors and is the most starred project in the TxPipe portfolio.
Oura has previously been funded twice through Project Catalyst, in Fund 9 and Fund 13, for feature development.
TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 successfully delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The requested amount is asserted not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission, either alone or in aggregate.

Intersect will administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with admin, leadership, and six-entity external oversight permissions, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA for 12 months of Oura maintenance by TxPipe, routed through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, and presents Oura as open-source Cardano event-pipeline infrastructure with prior funding history, usage indicators, Intersect budget-process support, NCL compliance, and oversight controls.
